instruction.name: vbitsel.v
instruction.description: Compute bitwise selection: for each bit position, if the bit in `c` equals to one, copy the bit from `b` to `dst`, otherwise copy from `a`.

experiments.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 1000 --unroll2 4000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr3, $r4' --asm 'vbitsel.v $vr0, $vr0, $vr1, $vr2'
